description: Create an empty website, app, or agent in an organization, before publishing to it. This is the first step for anything new: publish_site, publish_app, and publish_agent change a service that exists and refuse a name that does not. Pass kind to say which you mean, and name to choose its name; omit name to have one generated. A name another website, app, or agent in the organization holds is refused, as is a create past the organization's limit for that kind. The result names the organization, kind, name, and URL; publish to the name next. Requires connecting a Valet account.

idempotency_key.description: An opaque key of your choosing. Repeating a call with the same key returns the first call's result instead of creating a second service, which makes a retry safe.

kind.description: Required. What to create: a static website, a Procfile app, or an agent.

name.description: The service's name. For a website or app it becomes the first label of its URL. Omit to have one generated.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to create it in. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: create_service
title: Create a website, app, or agent
